exam_scheme.note: The National Entrance Screening Test (NEST) is a compulsory nationwide Computer Based Test conducted for admission to the 5-year Integrated M.Sc. programme in basic sciences (Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Physics) at the National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER), Bhubaneswar and the University of Mumbai - Department of Atomic Energy Centre for Excellence in Basic Sciences (UM-DAE CEBS), Mumbai. NEST is a 210-minute (3.5 hours) examination carrying 200 total marks across four subject sections of 50 marks each: Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Physics. Each section contains both single-choice and multiple-choice questions. For generating the final merit list, only the best three scores out of the four subject sections are counted (total evaluation out of 150 marks). All admitted students receive an annual DISHA scholarship of ₹60,000 plus ₹20,000 annual mentorship grant from the Department of Atomic Energy.
